scope: PRs authored by enyst with a head branch starting claude/umbrella-bug-fixes-, including merged and closed PRs.
writing: ASD-STE100-inspired plain English; not certified controlled English.
sources: Summaries of public PR descriptions; not independent code reviews or test reruns.

prs.title: fix(agent-server): answer 409 and keep state when a write loses ownership
prs.heading: Keep refused writes out of memory
prs.summary: The server returns 409 when another server owns the conversation. It keeps the previous title, tags and secrets when it cannot save a change.

prs.title: fix(agent-server): post full webhook batches off the event's publish
prs.heading: Keep slow webhooks from blocking runs
prs.summary: The server sends full webhook batches in the background. A slow receiver no longer keeps a finished run busy.

prs.title: fix(agent-server): answer 409 when a continued gateway run waits for confirmation
prs.heading: Report a paused gateway run at once
prs.summary: A continued chat request returns 409 when the agent pauses or needs confirmation. The client no longer waits for a timeout.

prs.title: fix(agent-server): report real usage buckets in telemetry outcome events
prs.heading: Report known usage in telemetry
prs.summary: The server reads token and cost totals before it sends the run outcome. Telemetry reports usage ranges instead of “unknown” when totals are available.

prs.title: fix(sdk): keep streamed deltas out of RemoteConversation.state.events
prs.heading: Keep token chunks out of saved history
prs.summary: The Python remote client sends streaming chunks to listeners without adding them to state.events. Its cached history matches the server’s stored events.

prs.title: fix(sdk): deliver streamed deltas to RemoteConversation token_callbacks
prs.heading: Deliver remote token callbacks
prs.summary: The Python remote client calls token_callbacks as token chunks arrive. Applications can display the agent’s text while it is generated.

prs.title: fix(agent-server): describe the secret-key fallback of TelemetrySpec.salt
prs.heading: Explain when telemetry IDs stay the same
prs.summary: The API description explains that telemetry uses the server secret when no salt is set. Operators can see why conversation IDs remain linkable across restarts.

prs.title: fix(agent-server): reject a create whose agent tool module cannot be imported
prs.heading: Reject tools the server cannot load
prs.summary: The server rejects a new conversation if it cannot import a required custom tool module. It no longer accepts the conversation and fails on its first message.

prs.title: fix(typescript-client): type GitChange.status with the server's wire values
prs.heading: Match Git status types to the API
prs.summary: The TypeScript client uses the Git status values that the server sends, such as UPDATED. Applications can compare these values without incorrect type errors.

prs.title: fix(typescript): resolve updateConversation with the updated conversation
prs.heading: Return the updated conversation
prs.summary: The TypeScript updateConversation method returns the updated conversation data. Callers receive its ID and title instead of only a success flag.

prs.title: fix(agent-server): reserve the run slot before a gateway turn saves its message
prs.heading: Avoid duplicate messages after a busy response
prs.summary: The gateway reserves a run slot before it saves a continued chat message. A refused request returns 429 without adding a message that a retry would duplicate.

prs.title: fix(agent-server): answer /run 409 without waiting for the state lock
prs.heading: Respond quickly when a run is already active
prs.summary: The run endpoint returns 409 without waiting for a long tool call to finish. The Python remote client can then wait for the existing run without a trigger timeout.

prs.title: fix(agent-server): post webhook events that fill the buffer during an in-flight batch
prs.heading: Send webhook batches that fill during a send
prs.summary: The server checks the webhook buffer after a batch finishes sending. It sends another full batch at once instead of waiting for a timer or new events.

prs.title: fix(agent-server): let OH_*_IS_NONE=1 clear a config file value
prs.heading: Let environment settings clear file values
prs.summary: An OH_*_IS_NONE=1 setting clears a nullable value from the configuration file. The file value no longer overrides an explicit request for null.

prs.title: fix(sdk): pass events missed during a WebSocket reconnect to RemoteConversation callbacks
prs.heading: Deliver events missed during reconnect
prs.summary: The Python remote client calls listeners for stored events recovered after a WebSocket reconnect. A live display no longer misses those events.

prs.title: fix(agent-server): report deferred_init true from initialized deferred pods
prs.heading: Identify pods that started with deferred setup
prs.summary: Telemetry keeps the pod’s original deferred_init flag after initialization. Operators can distinguish these pods from servers that started normally.

prs.title: fix(agent-server): refuse overlapping chat turns on one conversation with 409
prs.heading: Refuse overlapping turns in one chat
prs.summary: The gateway returns 409 if another request already uses the same conversation. Each accepted request receives the answer to its own turn.

prs.title: fix(agent-server): remove the per-server TMUX_TMPDIR on shutdown
prs.heading: Remove temporary tmux folders
prs.summary: The server removes the tmux folder it created when it shuts down normally. Repeated starts no longer leave those folders behind.

prs.title: fix(agent-server): report a failed skills sync fetch as an error
prs.heading: Report a failed skills sync
prs.summary: The sync endpoint reports an error when it cannot fetch repository updates. It no longer describes use of an old cached copy as a successful sync.

prs.title: fix(agent-server): correct WebhookSpec base_url and flush_delay descriptions
prs.heading: Correct the webhook API descriptions
prs.summary: The API description gives the actual event URL, including the conversation ID. It also explains that new events do not restart the flush timer.

prs.title: fix(agent-server): answer uploads onto a directory or below a file with 400
prs.heading: Report invalid upload targets as client errors
prs.summary: An upload returns 400 if its target is a directory or a parent is a regular file. The client can distinguish an invalid path from a server failure.

prs.title: fix(agent-server): tie uvicorn proxy_headers to trust_forwarded_headers
prs.heading: Apply the forwarded-header trust setting
prs.summary: The server only lets proxy headers change the request scheme when trust_forwarded_headers allows it. Untrusted headers no longer change the app bridge’s origin check.

prs.title: fix(agent-server): answer 409 for meta-profile activation over a corrupted settings file
prs.heading: Report unreadable settings during activation
prs.summary: Meta-profile activation returns 409 when the settings file is corrupt or uses another encryption key. The response no longer exposes the file path in an unhandled error.

prs.title: fix(agent-server): apply enable_browser to /server_info usable_tools
prs.heading: Hide a disabled browser from usable tools
prs.summary: The server leaves the browser out of server_info.usable_tools when enable_browser is false. Clients no longer offer a tool that conversations cannot use.

prs.title: fix(agent-server): leave web-researcher out of sub-agents when the browser is disabled
prs.heading: Hide the browser-only sub-agent when disabled
prs.summary: The server leaves web-researcher out of the sub-agent list when the browser is disabled. Clients no longer offer a sub-agent with no usable tool.

prs.title: fix(agent-server): stop bridging to a crashed Canvas backend
prs.heading: Stop forwarding to a crashed app backend
prs.summary: The app bridge detects a dead backend before it forwards requests or creates sessions. Clients receive a backend status error instead of a misleading container error.

prs.title: fix(agent-server): keep the client's body framing in proxied requests
prs.heading: Preserve request body framing through the proxy
prs.summary: The proxy preserves the client’s body length or chunked framing. Backends that read Content-Length can receive the full request body.

prs.title: fix(agent-server): refuse a non-gzip canvas backend artifact with 409
prs.heading: Reject invalid app backend archives
prs.summary: Backend preparation returns 409 when an artifact is not a valid gzip tar archive. The client receives a reason instead of an unhandled 500 error.

prs.title: fix(agent-server): drop upstream Date and Server from proxied responses
prs.heading: Remove duplicate proxy response headers
prs.summary: The proxy removes the upstream Date and Server headers before the server adds its own. Responses no longer contain duplicate dates or disclose the backend’s server header.

prs.title: fix(sdk): accept the documented github:owner/repo/<path> install source
prs.heading: Accept the documented GitHub install path
prs.summary: Extension installation accepts github:owner/repo/path. Users can select a folder within the repository through the documented shorthand.

prs.title: fix(tools): find Playwright Chromium under PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH
prs.heading: Find Chromium in the configured Playwright folder
prs.summary: The browser tool checks PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH for Chromium. Containers and CI systems can use the browser they installed there.

prs.title: fix(agent-server): don't advertise a VS Code URL while VS Code is not running
prs.heading: Do not offer a dead VS Code link
prs.summary: The server returns no VS Code URL when VS Code is not running. It no longer offers a broken link that contains a session token.

prs.title: fix(agent-server): answer 400/422 when refreshing an unfetchable skill or plugin
prs.heading: Report skill and plugin refresh errors clearly
prs.summary: Refresh returns 400 or 422 for an unavailable source, invalid content or a local installation. These cases no longer appear as unhandled server failures.

prs.title: fix(sdk): name a manifest-less git repository plugin after the repository
prs.heading: Give plugins a stable repository name
prs.summary: A Git plugin without a root manifest takes its name from the repository. Its installed name no longer includes the clone cache’s URL hash.

prs.title: fix(agent-server): keep the managed-key refresh hook after an LLM switch
prs.heading: Keep managed-key refresh after a model switch
prs.summary: A replacement LLM receives the managed-key refresh hook. A model switch no longer disables the configured refresh and retry after an authentication failure.

prs.title: fix(agent-server): clear the skills marketplace cache on sync
prs.heading: Refresh the marketplace list after sync
prs.summary: Skills sync clears the marketplace cache. The next catalog request can show the updated repository instead of an old or empty list.

prs.title: fix(agent-server): make file upload overwrites atomic
prs.heading: Protect existing files during uploads
prs.summary: The server writes an upload to a temporary file before replacing the destination. A failed overwrite no longer truncates the previous file.

prs.title: fix(sdk): reject skill installs with unparsable frontmatter as invalid
prs.heading: Reject invalid skill metadata cleanly
prs.summary: The installer treats unreadable YAML frontmatter as an invalid skill. The API returns 422 instead of exposing an unhandled parser error.

prs.title: fix(agent-server): map profile-store errors in scoped secrets list
prs.heading: Handle profile errors when listing scoped secrets
prs.summary: The secrets endpoint maps invalid agent profiles to 400 and a busy profile store to 503. These cases no longer return an unhandled 500 error.

prs.title: fix(agent-server): report applied=false when meta-profile activation cannot route
prs.heading: Report when a meta-profile was not applied
prs.summary: Activation reports applied=false when the agent cannot use model routing. Clients no longer receive an apparent success for a profile that was not activated.

prs.title: fix(sdk): keep edge whitespace on the original side of a git diff
prs.heading: Preserve whitespace on both sides of a diff
prs.summary: The SDK keeps indentation and trailing blank lines in the original Git content. An unchanged file no longer shows a false diff.

prs.title: fix(agent-server): refuse meta-profiles that can never route
prs.heading: Reject a router with no routing choices
prs.summary: The server rejects a meta-profile that cannot select a destination. It no longer stores a configuration that makes a paid classifier call with no usable choices.

prs.title: fix(agent-server): answer gateway errors when OpenAI device login fails upstream
prs.heading: Report upstream device-login failures
prs.summary: The OpenAI device-login endpoints return gateway errors for upstream connection failures, timeouts and error responses. Clients can distinguish a provider problem from a local server failure.

prs.title: fix(sdk): drop Bedrock-only ids from the supported model list
prs.heading: Remove Bedrock-only models from direct-provider lists
prs.summary: The model list excludes Bedrock-only IDs when AWS credentials are unavailable. Users of a direct provider no longer select an ID that requires AWS.

prs.title: fix(sdk): expand ~ in OH_PERSISTENCE_DIR for the meta-profile store
prs.heading: Use the home folder for meta-profile storage
prs.summary: The meta-profile store expands ~ in OH_PERSISTENCE_DIR. It writes beside the other settings instead of creating a folder literally named ~.

prs.title: fix(ts-client): match agent-profile payload types to the server models
prs.heading: Match agent-profile types to server data
prs.summary: The TypeScript client adds the profile fields the server sends and removes incorrect requirements. Profile editors can read and save the actual API payloads.

prs.title: fix(agent-server): keep agent profile identity for .json-suffixed names
prs.heading: Keep profile identity for names ending in .json
prs.summary: The server treats a profile name with or without .json as the same name. Saving it again preserves its ID and keeps active references valid.

prs.title: fix(agent-server): honor UTC offsets in bash event timestamp filters
prs.heading: Respect time zones in command event filters
prs.summary: Bash event searches apply the UTC offset in each timestamp. Different timestamp forms for the same instant return the same events.

prs.title: fix(agent-server): describe the real materialize report in the seed docstring
prs.heading: Correct the default-profile setup description
prs.summary: The source documentation names the actual materialize result for a missing default LLM profile. It no longer tells readers to look for a field that is not returned.

prs.title: fix(sdk): classify a BadRequestError carrying HTTP 401/403 as an auth error
prs.heading: Classify HTTP 401 and 403 as authentication failures
prs.summary: The SDK recognizes authentication status codes even when the provider library calls them BadRequestError. A bad key no longer appears as a general request error.

prs.title: fix(agent-server): guard LLM profile delete through the .json alias
prs.heading: Apply profile deletion guards to .json aliases
prs.summary: Deleting an LLM profile through its .json name checks existing references. Rename and delete also update active pointers through that alias.

prs.title: fix(agent-server): reject MCP OAuth callback URLs with a bad port as 400
prs.heading: Reject invalid OAuth callback ports
prs.summary: The MCP OAuth callback endpoint returns 400 for a non-numeric or out-of-range port. Invalid URLs no longer cause an unhandled server error.

prs.title: fix(agent-server): answer replayed MCP OAuth callbacks with the job status
prs.heading: Handle repeated OAuth callbacks
prs.summary: The MCP OAuth callback endpoint returns the job status after the job ends. Repeated submissions no longer try to contact a closed callback server.

prs.title: fix(agent-server): skip the workspaces save when a write changes nothing
prs.heading: Skip workspace writes that change nothing
prs.summary: The workspace registry does not rewrite its file for a no-op request. Deleting an unknown path no longer creates a file or fails because storage is read-only.

prs.title: fix(agent-server): refuse PATCH /api/settings pointers to missing profiles
prs.heading: Reject settings that name missing profiles
prs.summary: The settings endpoint checks active agent and meta-profile references before saving them. It no longer accepts a pointer to a profile that does not exist.

prs.title: fix(agent-server): URL-encode the VS Code URL's folder and token
prs.heading: Encode VS Code folders and tokens in links
prs.summary: The server URL-encodes the folder and token query values. Spaces, ampersands and hash signs no longer make VS Code open the wrong folder.

prs.title: fix(sdk): persist a mid-step switch_llm before it returns
prs.heading: Save a model switch before confirming it
prs.summary: A model or profile switch made during an agent step is saved before the endpoint returns. Reads and restarts no longer see the previous model after an acknowledged switch.

prs.title: fix(sdk): diff a working-tree-deleted file against its base text
prs.heading: Show diffs for deleted working files
prs.summary: The SDK compares a deleted file with its original Git content. The Changes view can show the deletion instead of returning “file does not exist”.

prs.title: fix(agent-server): report the uploaded file_size in the upload response
prs.heading: Return the uploaded byte count
prs.summary: The upload response includes file_size. Python and TypeScript callers can report how many bytes they wrote instead of receiving no size.

prs.title: fix(agent-server): accept the workspace cookie on the Docker-mode workspace root
prs.heading: Accept the workspace cookie without a trailing slash
prs.summary: In Docker mode, the workspace root accepts its session cookie with or without a trailing slash. Embedded workspace pages no longer fail authentication on the shorter URL.

prs.title: fix(agent-server): describe nested-repository resolution in archive params
prs.heading: Explain which folder an archive contains
prs.summary: The archive API description explains its nested-repository selection. Users can see when files beside the selected repository will be left out.

prs.title: fix(agent-server): page search_subdirs past names that differ only by case
prs.heading: Advance folder pages past case-only name differences
prs.summary: Directory search uses a cursor that distinguishes names such as Foo and foo. Clients can load the next page without repeating the same folder forever.

prs.title: fix(sdk): install the edited profile when switch_profile re-switches
prs.heading: Use the latest saved profile when switching
prs.summary: Switching back to a profile loads its current configuration. A conversation no longer reuses an old model or key cached before the profile was edited.

prs.title: fix(agent-server): document 422 for an invalid secret name
prs.heading: Document the correct invalid-secret status
prs.summary: The API description says an invalid secret name returns 422. It now matches the status the GET and DELETE endpoints already return.

prs.title: fix(agent-server): keep conversations with running scoped bash commands loaded
prs.heading: Keep running commands alive during idle cleanup
prs.summary: The server keeps a conversation loaded while a scoped Bash command runs. Idle cleanup no longer kills the command before it reports an exit code.

prs.title: fix(sdk): list git changes of a repository subdirectory relative to it
prs.heading: Use one path base for subfolder Git changes
prs.summary: Git changes requested from a repository subfolder are relative to that subfolder. The response no longer mixes repository paths with subfolder paths.

prs.title: fix(agent-server): apply bash order__gt filter before paging
prs.heading: Filter command events before making pages
prs.summary: Bash event search applies order__gt before the page limit. Polling clients can receive later output chunks and the command’s exit code.

prs.title: fix(agent-server): answer 422 for a malformed id on scoped bash routes
prs.heading: Reject malformed conversation IDs on Bash routes
prs.summary: Conversation-scoped Bash endpoints return 422 when an ID is not a UUID. They no longer read missing request state and fail with 500.

prs.title: fix(agent-server): keep resumed goal loops within max_iterations
prs.heading: Keep resumed goal loops within their limit
prs.summary: Resuming a goal does not add agent rounds beyond max_iterations. An interrupted judge call no longer causes the agent to exceed the user’s limit.

prs.title: fix(sdk): refuse a live ACP switch to a model the session does not offer with 400
prs.heading: Reject an unavailable live ACP model
prs.summary: A live ACP model switch returns 400 if the session does not offer that model. Clients no longer see a server error for a model choice that cannot work.

prs.title: fix(agent-server): ignore pending credential bindings for non-ACP conversations
prs.heading: Ignore ACP credentials for non-ACP conversations
prs.summary: Pending runtime credential bindings are not applied to regular conversations. Those conversations no longer become blocked on credentials they do not use.

prs.title: fix(agent-server): read agent_final_response from the active branch
prs.heading: Read the final answer from the active branch
prs.summary: The final-response endpoint reads only the conversation’s current branch. After navigation, it no longer returns an answer from an abandoned branch.

prs.title: fix(agent-server): answer 409 when condense has no request-handling condenser
prs.heading: Explain when context condensation is unavailable
prs.summary: The condense endpoint returns 409 if the agent has no condenser that can handle the request. Clients can distinguish this configuration limit from a server failure.

prs.title: fix(agent-server): return 404 from ask_agent for an unknown conversation
prs.heading: Return 404 for questions to unknown conversations
prs.summary: The ask_agent endpoint returns 404 when the conversation does not exist. A missing conversation no longer looks like a model or server failure.

prs.title: fix(sdk): publish a user message before its last_user_message_id update
prs.heading: Publish user messages in stored order
prs.summary: The SDK publishes a user message before the state update that refers to it. Clients that resume from event sequence numbers no longer risk skipping the message.

prs.title: fix(agent-server): return 404/null for an unknown event id
prs.heading: Handle missing event IDs without failing the batch
prs.summary: A single missing event returns 404. A batch keeps the other events and returns null in the missing event’s position.

prs.title: fix(agent-server): refuse switch_llm/switch_profile on ACP conversations
prs.heading: Refuse SDK model switches on ACP conversations
prs.summary: The server rejects switch_llm and switch_profile for ACP conversations. It no longer reports a successful switch that cannot change the subprocess’s model.

prs.title: fix(sdk): keep one copy of a plugin's hooks when it is loaded twice
prs.heading: Load a plugin’s hooks only once
prs.summary: Loading the same plugin twice keeps one copy of its hooks. A retry no longer makes each hook run twice for a user message.

prs.title: fix(agent-server): return 404 for unknown ids on pause, interrupt, PATCH and DELETE
prs.heading: Use 404 for unknown conversation actions
prs.summary: Pause, interrupt, update and delete return 404 for an unknown conversation ID. Clients no longer receive a misleading bad request or successful update response.

prs.title: docs(typescript): describe the pre-run 200-and-defer switchAcpModel behaviour
prs.heading: Document ACP model changes before the first run
prs.summary: The TypeScript documentation explains that a pre-run model switch returns 200 and saves the choice for later. It no longer describes a 409 response that the server does not send.

prs.title: fix(sdk): refuse a blank ACP model before the first run
prs.heading: Reject a blank ACP model before the first run
prs.summary: The SDK rejects empty or whitespace-only model IDs before an ACP session starts. It no longer saves a model choice that a live session would refuse.

prs.title: fix(agent-server): reject non-user roles on POST events with 422
prs.heading: Reject non-user input messages before initialization
prs.summary: The events endpoint returns 422 for assistant, system or tool input roles. It rejects them before creating a system prompt or initializing the agent.

prs.title: fix(agent-server): stamp callback events when they are appended
prs.heading: Timestamp callback events when they enter the log
prs.summary: The server timestamps callback events when it appends them. Timestamp-based history reads no longer miss updates created earlier but stored later.

prs.title: fix(agent-server): reject a whitespace-only conversation title on PATCH
prs.heading: Reject titles that contain only whitespace
prs.summary: The update endpoint returns 422 for a whitespace-only title. It no longer clears the existing title and prevents automatic title generation.

prs.title: fix(sdk): refuse a non-object discriminated-union input with a ValidationError
prs.heading: Reject secret values with the wrong JSON shape
prs.summary: The SDK reports a validation error when a discriminated-union value is not an object. Invalid secret strings, numbers, booleans or null produce 422 instead of an internal error.

prs.title: fix(agent-server): apply init-delivered allow_cors_origins to CORS
prs.heading: Apply CORS origins delivered during initialization
prs.summary: The server updates its browser-origin checks from the initialization settings. Browsers from those allowed origins can pass the preflight request.

prs.title: fix(agent-server): reject MCP servers with neither command nor url
prs.heading: Reject MCP entries with no command or URL
prs.summary: The settings endpoint rejects an MCP server with neither command nor url. One empty entry no longer prevents tools from valid neighboring entries from loading.

prs.title: fix(agent-server): refuse more than 99 batch-get ids with a 422
prs.heading: Validate the conversation batch size
prs.summary: Batch conversation lookup returns 422 when a request exceeds 99 IDs. The API publishes the limit and enforces it even when Python assertions are disabled.

prs.title: fix(agent-server): keep the server responsive while a profile store lock is held
prs.heading: Keep profile lock waits off the event loop
prs.summary: A request waiting for a profile-store lock no longer blocks unrelated requests and sockets. The server can still answer health checks while the store is busy.

prs.title: fix(sdk): fail extension installs whose ref a cached clone cannot check out
prs.heading: Reject an install when the requested Git ref is absent
prs.summary: The installer fails if a cached clone cannot check out the requested ref. It no longer replaces an extension with another commit while reporting success.

prs.title: fix(agent-server): scope the workspace session cookie to the root path
prs.heading: Scope workspace cookies to the configured URL prefix
prs.summary: The workspace cookie includes the server’s path prefix. Browsers behind a prefix proxy can authenticate embedded workspace pages.

prs.title: fix(agent-server): persist secret, policy and analyzer changes in base_state
prs.heading: Save secrets and security settings across restarts
prs.summary: The SDK saves secret, confirmation-policy and security-analyzer changes in conversation state. Resume no longer restores old creation-time values or loses the last secret update.

prs.title: fix(agent-server): treat IPv6 loopback Host as a secure context
prs.heading: Accept IPv6 loopback as a secure browser context
prs.summary: The workspace-session endpoint recognizes ::1 correctly. Browsers on IPv6 loopback receive a cookie they can use for workspace embeds.

prs.title: fix(agent-server): reject blank and redacted provider-connection api_key
prs.heading: Reject empty and masked provider keys
prs.summary: Provider connection create and update reject blank keys and the redacted placeholder. Clients no longer clear a shared key or save the mask as a real key by accident.

prs.title: fix(ts): honor maxIterations and stuckDetection in ConversationManager.createConversation
prs.heading: Send conversation limits from the manager
prs.summary: The TypeScript manager sends maxIterations and stuckDetection when it creates a conversation. The server no longer silently uses defaults instead of the caller’s choices.

prs.title: fix(git): keep file names verbatim in git changes and commit changes
prs.heading: Keep Git filenames unchanged
prs.summary: Git change lists preserve spaces and non-ASCII characters in filenames. One such name no longer breaks the whole Changes view or appears in a damaged escaped form.

prs.title: fix(agent-server): serve trajectories from the init-time conversations path
prs.heading: Download histories from the initialized storage path
prs.summary: Trajectory downloads use the conversation folder chosen during server initialization. Deferred-init servers no longer look in the old launch-time folder.

prs.title: fix(agent-server): log failed runs without rendering a rich traceback on the loop
prs.heading: Keep error logging from freezing the server
prs.summary: The server avoids slow rich traceback rendering on the event loop when a run fails. Other requests and sockets can remain responsive during error reporting.

prs.title: fix(sdk): install the posted LLM when switch_llm targets a registered usage_id
prs.heading: Apply a posted model even when its usage ID is known
prs.summary: The SDK installs the new LLM configuration when switch_llm uses an existing usage_id. The endpoint no longer reports success while keeping the old model.

prs.title: fix(agent-server): return the whole output from execute_bash_command
prs.heading: Return all command output chunks
prs.summary: The synchronous Bash endpoint collects all stored output and the final exit code. Large output no longer loses earlier chunks or appears successful before completion.

prs.title: fix(agent-server): re-read meta.json when loading a persisted conversation
prs.heading: Reload conversation metadata before takeover
prs.summary: A server reads the latest saved metadata when it loads a conversation. It no longer overwrites another server’s newer title, tags or secrets with its startup copy.

prs.title: fix(sdk): persist state changes made while a step waits on the model
prs.heading: Save state changes while the model is responding
prs.summary: The SDK saves changes such as pause while a model call is still in progress. API reads and restarts can see the acknowledged change without waiting for the model.

prs.title: fix(agent-server): refuse activating or re-saving a profile under a changed cipher key
prs.heading: Protect profiles when the encryption key changes
prs.summary: The server refuses to activate or overwrite a profile whose encrypted key is unreadable. It preserves the encrypted value so restoring the original key can recover it.

prs.title: fix(agent-server): reap Canvas backends orphaned by a crashed server
prs.heading: Clean up app backends after a server crash
prs.summary: The server tracks backend processes across restarts and removes verified orphans. A crash no longer leaves an old backend running beside a new copy on the same data.

prs.title: fix(agent-server): accept short event kinds in events search and count
prs.heading: Accept the documented short event names
prs.summary: Event search and count accept names such as MessageEvent. Clients following the API description no longer receive an empty history for existing events.

prs.title: fix(agent-server): mark a goal loop left active at restart as interrupted
prs.heading: Mark unfinished goals as interrupted after restart
prs.summary: The server records an interrupted goal when no loop remains after restart. Clients no longer display that goal as running forever.

prs.title: fix(sdk): resume a conversation whose custom tool module is gone
prs.heading: Resume history after a custom tool module disappears
prs.summary: The SDK skips unavailable custom tools and unrecognized stored event types with warnings during resume. A missing module no longer prevents the conversation from loading.

prs.title: fix(sdk): keep discriminated-union validation from mutating its input
prs.heading: Leave validation input unchanged
prs.summary: Discriminated-union validation no longer removes kind from the supplied object. Repeated reads of remote agent and security settings remain valid.

prs.title: fix(typescript): use the global WebSocket in the callback socket clients
prs.heading: Use the available global WebSocket
prs.summary: The TypeScript callback clients use globalThis.WebSocket when available. They can deliver events in modern Node without calling require inside an ES module.

prs.title: fix(agent-server): bound profile pre-flight and reject exhausted quotas
prs.heading: Bound profile checks and reject exhausted quotas
prs.summary: Profile validation uses a short request and retry policy. It also treats an exhausted budget or quota as invalid instead of reporting a usable key.

prs.title: fix(agent-server): load skills marketplace from .plugin manifest first
prs.heading: Read the real marketplace manifest
prs.summary: The server checks the .plugin marketplace manifest before the old fallback path. The Marketplace tab can list the public extensions repository instead of showing no skills.

prs.title: fix(agent-server): give each trajectory download its own temp zip
prs.heading: Give each history download its own archive
prs.summary: Each trajectory download uses a separate temporary ZIP file. Parallel downloads no longer overwrite or delete the file another response is sending.

prs.title: fix(sdk): keep the source's cipher and secrets on a forked conversation
prs.heading: Keep credentials when branching a conversation
prs.summary: The SDK carries the source cipher and secrets into a fork. A new branch no longer loses its stored LLM key and fails on its first turn.

prs.title: fix(typescript): keep reconnecting when a refused handshake fires only error
prs.heading: Retry WebSocket handshakes that emit only errors
prs.summary: The TypeScript event stream schedules another connection attempt after an error-only handshake failure. It can recover when a server is down or restarting.

prs.title: fix(agent-server): negotiate WebSocket subprotocols through the app-backend bridge
prs.heading: Forward WebSocket subprotocols through the app bridge
prs.summary: The bridge negotiates a subprotocol with the backend before accepting the browser connection. Apps that require a protocol can complete the handshake.

prs.title: fix(ts-client): keep binary bytes in RemoteWorkspace downloads
prs.heading: Preserve binary downloads
prs.summary: The TypeScript remote workspace reads downloads as bytes. Binary files no longer pass through UTF-8 text decoding and return corrupted content.

prs.title: fix(agent-server): report per-request usage on continued chat completions
prs.heading: Report token usage for each continued chat request
prs.summary: The gateway returns the tokens used by the current request, including streamed usage. Clients no longer count all earlier turns again.

prs.title: fix(agent-server): support cipher key rotation and refuse writes under a lost key
prs.heading: Support encryption-key rotation without losing secrets
prs.summary: The server supports key rotation and refuses writes that would erase values encrypted with a lost key. Existing encrypted settings remain recoverable instead of being replaced with null.

prs.title: fix(agent-server): close conversation sockets on delete and sandbox pause
prs.heading: Close sockets when a conversation is removed or paused
prs.summary: The server closes event and session sockets on delete or sandbox pause. Clients can detect the change and reconnect rather than staying attached to a discarded service.

prs.title: fix(sdk): drop a since-disabled ambient plugin's skills and MCP servers on resume
prs.heading: Remove disabled plugin contributions on resume
prs.summary: The SDK removes a disabled ambient plugin’s skills and MCP servers when it resumes a conversation. It no longer restores those contributions from old saved agent state.

prs.title: fix(agent-server): resolve provider connection in profile validate
prs.heading: Use the linked provider key during profile validation
prs.summary: Validation resolves a draft profile’s saved provider connection. A profile without an inline key can pass the same key check used during activation.

prs.title: fix(sdk): list changes of a repository below a non-repository path
prs.heading: Find Git changes below the workspace root
prs.summary: Git change lookup checks for a repository below a non-repository folder. A Changes view using the workspace root no longer misses edits in that repository.

prs.title: fix(agent-server): read an unreachable OpenAI refresh as disconnected
prs.heading: Report an offline OpenAI login as disconnected
prs.summary: The subscription status endpoint reports connected=false if OpenAI cannot be reached during a token refresh. It keeps the saved credentials so the connection can recover when the network returns.

prs.title: fix(agent-server): forward ?path= on the bare Canvas app-backend root route
prs.heading: Preserve the path query on app root requests
prs.summary: The app bridge forwards a path query parameter as query data on the root route. It no longer mistakes that value for the backend URL path.

prs.title: fix(agent-server): re-probe a Canvas App backend after a missed health probe
prs.heading: Check backend health again after a slow response
prs.summary: The server checks a live backend again after a failed health probe. A temporary delay no longer leaves a recovered app marked unhealthy until restart.

prs.title: fix(sdk): skip sub-agents whose skill is missing instead of failing
prs.heading: Skip sub-agents with missing skills
prs.summary: The SDK skips a sub-agent definition that names a missing skill and logs a warning. Other sub-agents still load, and the missing skill no longer breaks the conversation.
